premiumInterviewPreviews.array-like-and-iterables: Covers how these three categories overlap, which array methods work on each, and how to convert between them.
premiumInterviewPreviews.closures-practical-uses: Covers the patterns closures make possible in day-to-day code, and what each one buys you over the alternatives.
premiumInterviewPreviews.cors-basics: Covers which party enforces the rule, what the browser is protecting, and where the fix has to be made.
premiumInterviewPreviews.cors-preflight: Covers what makes a request simple rather than preflighted, and what the extra round trip is checking.
premiumInterviewPreviews.critical-rendering-path: Covers the stages between receiving HTML and painting pixels, and which resources block which stage.
premiumInterviewPreviews.dom-performance-reflow: Covers the read/write pattern that causes repeated layout work, and the techniques for rendering long lists.
premiumInterviewPreviews.dom-ready-and-script-loading: Covers how script placement and loading attributes decide whether the DOM exists when your code runs.
premiumInterviewPreviews.es-modules-vs-commonjs: Covers resolution, timing and syntax differences between the two module systems, and where each is used.
premiumInterviewPreviews.event-loop-microtasks-vs-tasks: Covers what lands in each queue, when each is drained, and what that ordering means in practice.
premiumInterviewPreviews.floating-point-money: Covers why binary representation loses certain decimals, and the standard strategies for monetary values.
premiumInterviewPreviews.iife-and-module-pattern: Covers the scoping problem this pattern solved before modules, and what replaced it.
premiumInterviewPreviews.implicit-conversion-plus: Covers the rules this operator follows and how to avoid depending on them.
premiumInterviewPreviews.javascript-closures: Covers what a closure captures, how long it lives, and the situations where that behaviour is the point.
premiumInterviewPreviews.javascript-event-loop: Covers the call stack, the queues, and the order in which pending work is picked up.
premiumInterviewPreviews.json-stringify-gotchas: Covers the values that do not survive the round trip, and what to do about each.
premiumInterviewPreviews.map-vs-object: Covers key types, ordering, size and iteration, and the cases that push you toward one or the other.
premiumInterviewPreviews.promise-all-failure: Covers what happens to the other promises, what the caller receives, and which combinator to reach for instead.
premiumInterviewPreviews.stacking-contexts: Covers the properties that establish one and why z-index sometimes appears to be ignored.
